description: Relationship uniqueness within a single pattern prevents reusing the same relationship.

source.scenario: [29] Fail when re-using a relationship in the same pattern

sqlpgq.reason: PostgreSQL SQL/PGQ (experimental: PostgreSQL 19 Beta 1-3 and 20 development builds) uses WALK traversal semantics and returns 2 rows because it reuses the single edge, whereas openCypher trail semantics enforces relationship uniqueness.
